candidates.change_summary: Delete the require that checks msg.sender == owner, allowing anyone to call sendTo.
Delete the require that checks amount > 0, allowing zero-amount transfers that still succeed (but change contract behavior by emitting no revert).
Change the owner check from msg.sender == owner to msg.sender != owner, inverting access control.
Replace receiver != address(0) with receiver == address(0), allowing only zero-address transfers.
Replace amount > 0 with amount == 0, allowing only zero-amount transfers.
Delete the actual transfer statement, so no ETH is sent regardless of checks.
